description: Blind paraphrase set for the dense leg. Unlike golden_eval.json (tuned against this catalog's own vocabulary), every `harvested` case is a verbatim user prompt pulled from this machine's OpenCode session DB before any question vectors existed, so neither the questions nor the descriptions were authored with these phrasings in view. `authored` cases cover skills the log never touched and are phrased deliberately without catalog nouns. Read the score as 'does the mechanism respond to how this user actually types', not as a forecast.
